material.desc: Gear records with serial number, photo and QR label; kits with their contents; dimensions and weight per case; check-outs and returns logged per shoot.
material.h1: The gear inventory, with a record of every movement.
material.sub: Each item has a record with its serial number, photo, category and status: in the warehouse, on a shoot or in repair. Check-outs and returns are recorded by scanning the QR label with a phone.
cifras: items with a record at the production company where it was developed
categories, from camera to sound, with their subcategories
warehouses per production company, at most
bloques: QR labels

Labels are generated in Bulx and printed on any printer. Scanning one with a phone opens the item record and logs who takes the item, when and for which project. Nothing needs to be installed on the phone.
Kits and contents
A kit is a record that contains others: the cases and the parts inside them. It goes out and comes back as one unit, and on return it is checked for anything missing.
Dimensions and weight
Length, width, height and weight of each case. Transport volume and weight are calculated per department and per project before loading.
Full record
Serial number, date added, price per day, photos, location and current project. Items in repair or retired are marked as such in the list.
Check-outs and returns
Each check-out and each return leaves a record of which gear went out, what came back and in what condition, with photos. Any issue creates a repair order.
Import and export
The inventory is imported from an existing Excel sheet and exported to Excel or to a Word list by department, for clients or insurers.
pasos: Import the inventory
From the current Excel sheet: items, categories and quantities. Bulx assigns a code to each item.
Print and attach the labels
One label per item or per case. They are printed from Bulx in whichever format is preferred.
Record check-outs and returns
By scanning the label at each movement. Any differences on return are flagged.
faq: Can it be used to rent gear out to third parties?
Yes. Each item has a price per day, quotes are built from the catalogue and the gear is reserved for the accepted dates.
Is a barcode scanner needed?
No. A phone camera is enough. The label opens a public page that shows neither serial numbers nor prices.
How many items can it hold?
There is no practical limit. The production company where it was developed manages more than 700, with filters by category, warehouse, project and status.

flota.titulo: Vehicle fleet booking for production companies
flota.desc: Vehicle booking calendar by project, MOT (roadworthiness test), insurance and service reminders, breakdown reports and check-out and return records.
flota.h1: The production fleet, in a booking calendar.
flota.sub: Each vehicle has its record, its documents with their expiry dates and its history. Bookings are made by project and by day; check-outs and returns are recorded by scanning the vehicle label.
cifras: vehicles managed at the production company where it was developed
advance notice of MOT (roadworthiness test) and insurance expiry
per vehicle to record check-outs and returns
bloques: Booking calendar
Week or month view, one vehicle per row. Bookings are linked to a project and cannot overlap. Workshop and MOT periods take up their slot in the same calendar.
MOT, insurance and servicing
Each vehicle stores its MOT, insurance and service dates. Upcoming expiries appear on the home page and under Tasks / MOT; appointments are noted and the result is recorded.
Label on the vehicle
Scanning the label records who takes the vehicle, at what mileage and for which project. On return, the mileage and the condition of the vehicle are recorded.
Inspections with photos
Check-out and return photos at every use. New damage can be attributed to the project and the date on which it appeared.
Breakdown reports
Breakdowns are reported from the phone with photos and a description. They create a workshop order and stay in the vehicle history with their cost.
Checklists
What has to be checked before each check-out and the pending tasks for each vehicle, with a person responsible and a date.
pasos: Add the vehicles
Registration number, type, mileage, MOT and insurance. They can also be imported from Excel.
Attach the label
One per vehicle, printed from Bulx.
Book by project
From the web or from the app. Check-outs and returns are recorded with the label.
faq: Does it handle vehicles hired for a project?
Yes. A vehicle can be owned or hired for specific dates, and it appears in the same calendar for that period.
Who can make bookings?
People with edit permission in Fleet. Everyone else can view the calendar without changing it. Permissions are assigned per person.
What happens with two bookings on the same dates?
The calendar does not allow bookings for the same vehicle to overlap: the second person sees that the vehicle is taken, and by whom.

presupuestos.titulo: Rental quotes for equipment and vehicles
presupuestos.desc: Rental quotes built from the catalogue: versions, sending by link, online acceptance by the client, reminders and automatic reservation of the gear.
presupuestos.h1: Quotes built from the catalogue, accepted online.
presupuestos.sub: The quote is built from the gear and vehicles in the catalogue, by day and by department. It is sent to the client as a link; on acceptance, the gear is reserved for those dates. Every change creates a version.
cifras: every change is saved with its date
per quote, with no account needed for the client
scheduled after the number of days you set
bloques: Built from the catalogue
Items and days are selected; the price per day and the totals are calculated. By department or sub-project, with discounts, and with or without VAT depending on the company’s settings.
Sent as a link
The client opens the quote in the browser, in the house style, and can accept it, request changes or comment. The time it was opened is recorded.
Scheduled reminders
If there is no reply, a reminder is sent by email after the configured number of days. The reminder is logged in the quote history.
Versions and acceptance
Every change creates a new version. The accepted version is locked, with its date, and the gear and vehicles are reserved for the project period.
Client record
Tax details, terms, contacts and all the client’s quotes: accepted, pending and expired, with the amounts for the year.
Documents in the house style
The quote is exported to PDF and to Word with the logo, the tax details and the terms, which are configured once in Settings.
pasos: Choose the client, dates and gear
From the catalogue, with the prices per day already set.
Send the link
By email, from Bulx, with the company signature.
Acceptance
The client accepts online and the gear is reserved. If there is no reply, a reminder is sent.
faq: Does Bulx issue invoices?
No. Bulx handles the quote up to acceptance; the invoice is issued with your usual accounting software. The quote is then marked as invoiced so that the finance figures reconcile.
Does the client need an account?
No. The link opens without registration. It has an expiry date and can be revoked.
Can quotes be broken down by department?
Yes. Camera, lighting, grip or any sub-project, each with its subtotal, plus the project total.

tecnologia.titulo: IT asset tracking: devices, lines and licences
tecnologia.desc: Computers and devices, phone lines, MiFi routers and software licences assigned to each person. Joiners and leavers, with a return list.
tecnologia.h1: Devices, lines and licences, assigned to each person.
tecnologia.sub: The production company’s IT equipment and its assignment: who has each device and since when, which lines are active and which licences are due for renewal.
cifras: devices with a record at the production company where it was developed
mobile and fixed lines, each with its provider
software licences with a renewal date
bloques: Devices
Laptops, phones, tablets and monitors with serial number, warranty, assigned person and assignment date. Each has its own QR label.
Staff leavers
When a person leaves, Bulx produces the list of what has to be returned and closed: devices, lines, MiFi routers, keys and access rights, with a deadline and follow-up.
Lines and MiFi routers
Each line with its provider, account holder, PIN and PUK. MiFi routers are assigned to a project when they go out and are then returned, like the gear.
Licences
By vendor: seats purchased, the people using them and the renewal date. Upcoming renewals appear on the Technology home page.
Company emails
The production company’s email library and each person’s signature, ready to use from their email client.
Renewals in view
Warranties and licences that are about to expire appear on the Technology home page before they lapse.
pasos: Import the devices
From the current Excel sheet, with serial number and assigned person.
Label them
Each device gets its QR label, so that it can be looked up from the iPhone.
Record handovers and returns
Every change of assignment is recorded, including from the phone.
faq: Is any other software needed?
No. Bulx runs in the browser and in the iPhone and iPad app; it does not depend on Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace.
Does it manage licences from any vendor?
Yes. Each vendor has its record with the seats purchased, the people assigned and the renewal date.
Does it include landlines?
Yes. Mobile and fixed lines, with extension, provider and account holder.

equipo.titulo: Film crew management: hours, permissions and chat
equipo.desc: Staff and crew records, hours per project from the phone or the Apple Watch, cost of in-house days, permissions by area and internal chat.
equipo.sub: Staff and crew, each with a record, a department and the gear assigned to them. Hours are logged from the app or the Apple Watch and allocated to the project. In the internal chat, a message can reference a quote, a vehicle or an item with its current status.
cifras: people, staff and crew, at the production company where it was developed
bloques: Staff and crew
Job title, department, contact details and the gear, devices and lines assigned. The crew of each project, with their roles and contact details.
Hours and in-house days
Each person logs their working day and their shooting days. Management sees the cost of each project in staff hours and compares it with the amount invoiced.
Internal chat
Conversations by project or by person. A message can include the card of a quote, a vehicle or an item, which shows its up-to-date status.
Permissions by area
Production, fleet, gear, IT, finance: per person and per level (read, edit, full). Amounts are visible only to those with Finance permission.
Projects and calendar
Each project with its dates, team, gear and quotes, and a production calendar showing each week’s shoots.
Announcements
Notices shown at sign-in: maintenance, a new feature, a presentation. Scheduled or immediate; only administrators can publish them.
pasos: Add the people
From an Excel sheet or one by one, each with a username and password.
Assign permissions
With templates by role (production, fleet, technician, management) and individual adjustments.
Log hours
From the app or the Apple Watch. They are allocated to the current project.
faq: Can people clock in from a phone?
Yes. From the iPhone and from the Apple Watch. The hours are stored on the person’s record and on the project record.
Does external crew need access?
It is not necessary. They are listed on the project record with their role and contact details. Limited access can be granted if required.
Does it replace the team’s messaging app?
For anything related to projects, yes: the chat includes references to the quote, the vehicle or the gear with their status, which avoids forwarding screenshots.

economia.titulo: Production finance reports: Excel and Power BI
economia.desc: Quoted, accepted and invoiced amounts by project, client and month. An Excel report with charts and a live data connection for Power BI.
economia.sub: The status of every quote (sent, accepted, invoiced) with its amounts, by project, by client and by month. The same data can be exported to Excel or queried live from Power BI.
cifras: confirmed and pending income, month by month
with tabs and charts generated by Bulx
bloques: Quote status
Drafts, sent, accepted and invoiced, with their amounts and their age. What has moved this month and what has gone a long time without a reply.
By project and by client
Amount for each project and each client over the year, average amount per quote and time to acceptance.
Excel report
An Excel workbook with the tabs and charts already built, for a management meeting or for the accountant.
Power BI
Bulx publishes its tables as an OData data source. Existing Power BI dashboards read the data directly, with no export step.
In-house cost
What a project costs in staff hours against the amount invoiced, by job title, department and project, with configurable rates.
Restricted access
Amounts are visible only to people with Finance permission. The rest of the team works without access to prices or totals.
pasos: Quote in Bulx
The financial data is derived from the quotes; it is not entered separately.
Mark what has been invoiced
When the invoice is issued in the accounting software, the quote is marked as invoiced.
Review
In Bulx, in the Excel report or in Power BI.
faq: Does it integrate with accounting software?
Not directly. Bulx does not issue invoices; quotes are marked as invoiced and the data is exported to Excel or read from Power BI.
What data is available to Power BI?
The same tables Bulx uses: quotes, projects, clients, gear and fleet, through a read-only user.
Are previous years kept?
Yes. Data is kept by year and by month from the first quote recorded.

app.titulo: The Bulx app for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
app.desc: The Bulx app for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch: QR label scanner, vehicle bookings, time logging, internal chat and notifications.
app.eyebrow: On iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
app.h1: The essentials of Bulx, from your phone.
app.sub: The app covers the work done on your feet: scanning labels, recording check-outs and returns, booking vehicles, clocking in and checking gear, fleet and projects. Quotes can be viewed in the app and are prepared on the web.
cifras: to clock in and check your hours
bloques: Label scanner
Gear, vehicles and devices. The camera reads the label and opens the record; the check-out or return is recorded on the spot.
Vehicle bookings
Choose the vehicle type and the days. The app shows availability and who has booked the other vehicles.
Chat and notifications
Team conversations, with quote, vehicle and gear cards, and notifications when there are messages or changes that affect the person.
Apple Watch
Clocking in and out and checking the day’s hours. The watch syncs with the iPhone.
Widgets
Free vehicles, gear out and the day’s hours on the home screen, without opening the app.
iPad
The same app, adapted to the iPad screen for fleet, gear and project records.
pasos: Install the app
From the App Store, for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
Sign in
With Apple, with Google or with the Bulx username; after that, with Face ID.
Scan
Anything recorded in the app appears on the web for the whole team.
faq: Is there an Android version?
Not at present. The app is for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. On Android, the web version is used from the browser; it is adapted to mobile screens.
Can quotes be prepared in the app?
No. They can be viewed and their status followed. Preparing and sending them is done on the web.
Does it work without signal?
Viewing data that is already loaded and scanning both work. Changes are sent when the connection returns.

seguridad.titulo: Security and data protection in Bulx
seguridad.desc: Two-step verification, permissions by area and level, an activity log that cannot be edited, servers in Frankfurt and external links that expire.
seguridad.h1: Who signs in, what they see and where the data is.
seguridad.sub: Production data belongs to the production company. Bulx documents how it is accessed, who can see each part, what has been changed and where it is stored.
cifras: mandatory six-digit code, every seven days
of every change: person, action and date
bloques: Sign in with Apple or Google
Each person can link their Apple or Google account and sign in with one click, without typing a password. Once someone has been removed, they can no longer sign in by any method.
Two-step verification
Required for everyone, at sign-in and every seven days: a six-digit code generated by an authenticator app (Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator or others). SMS is not used.
Permissions by area and level
Production, fleet, gear, IT, finance and system, with three levels: read, edit and full. What a person is not allowed to see does not appear on their screen.
Activity log
Every change is recorded with the person, the action and the date. The log cannot be edited or deleted, and it can be filtered by person, area and action.
Hosting in Europe
The servers and the database are in Frankfurt (Germany), with backups. Documents and photos are stored on an encrypted disk in the same region.
External links that expire
Anything shared outside the company (a quote, a calendar) has an expiry date and can be revoked. The public label pages show neither prices nor serial numbers.
pasos: Set up access
With a password, Apple or Google, and always with the two-step verification code.
Assign permissions
By area and by level, with templates by role.
Check the log
To see who did what, and when.
faq: Where is the data stored?
On servers in Frankfurt (Germany), in the European Union, with backups. Documents and photos are stored in the same region.
Can all the data be exported?
Yes. Gear, fleet, people, quotes and finance are exported to Excel; documents are exported as they are.
Who at Bulx has access to the data?
Only the staff who maintain the service, when the production company requests support, and that access is logged like any other.

demo.desc: A 30-minute demo by video call using your production company’s own inventory and fleet. No commitment and nothing to install.
demo.sub: Thirty minutes by video call. Your gear or vehicle spreadsheet is imported live and the demo goes through a working day: booking, gear check-out, quote and acceptance. At the end, you are given the price for your case.
cifras: by video call, on a date that suits you
bloques: With your gear
Your gear or vehicle spreadsheet is imported live. Within a few minutes you see your own warehouse inside Bulx.
A full working day
Booking a vehicle, checking out gear with the label, sending a quote and accepting it from the client’s side.
Price
It depends on the volume of gear and the number of people. It is set out at the demo, in writing and with no hidden conditions.
pasos: Write to us
An email with your name and the name of your production company.
Set a date
A thirty-minute video call.
Decide
With your gear inside Bulx and the price in writing.
faq: Does anything need to be installed for the demo?
No. It is a video call and a web page. Afterwards, access to a trial environment can be provided on request.
How much does Bulx cost?
It depends on the volume of gear and the number of people. It is set out in writing at the demo.
How long does it take to get started?
With the Excel sheet, one afternoon to import and label. Once the accounts have been created, the team can sign in the next day.

sobre.titulo: About Bulx: software built inside a production company
sobre.desc: Bulx was developed in 2026 inside Palma Pictures, a production company in Mallorca, to manage its gear, its fleet and its quotes.
sobre.sub: Bulx was built between August and October 2026 at Palma Pictures, based on what its production team and its technical department needed every day. It has been used at that production company from day one and is now offered to others.
cifras: the production company where it is used every day
Spanish, English and German on this website
bloques: The origin

A production company with a gear warehouse, a vehicle fleet and a team that goes out on shoots needed to know where everything was and who had it. The inventory came out of that, and the rest followed.
How it was built
Each part was requested by the warehouse, production or the technical department, tested on a real shoot and corrected with what was learned.
The name and the logo
The six areas (gear, fleet, quotes, IT, crew and finance) work like connected cells: a quote reserves gear, a booking takes up a vehicle. The logo is by Xavi Murillo.
pasos: August 2026
Started as Stock IT: the technical department’s inventory, on the web.
September 2026
Extended to fleet, quotes, crew and finance, and to the iPhone app.
October 2026
Renamed Bulx and offered to other production companies.
faq: Who is behind Bulx?
Palma Pictures, a production company in Mallorca, and Xavi Murillo, who is responsible for the product and designed the logo. Contact: info@bulx.es.
Why is it called Bulx?
After the honeycomb: separate, connected cells, like the areas of a production company.
Do other production companies use it?
It is beginning to be offered outside Palma Pictures. The first production companies interested can request a demo.

preguntas.desc: Answers about Bulx: installation, importing the inventory, permissions, where the data is stored, pricing and the trial period.
preguntas.sub: If your question is not here, write to info@bulx.es. We reply the same day.

software-productoras-audiovisuales.desc: Software for audiovisual production companies: gear inventory with QR labels, production fleet, rental quotes, crew and finance in one application.
software-productoras-audiovisuales.sub: Bulx brings together in one application what a production company usually spreads across Excel sheets, messages and folders: the gear inventory, the vehicle fleet, rental quotes, crew and finance. It was developed inside a production company in Mallorca and is used there on real shoots.
cifras: areas of the production company in a single application
items managed at the production company where it was developed
bloques: Gear inventory
One record per item, with serial number, photos, category and status. Kits with their contents, dimensions and weight per case, and a record of every check-out and every return.
Production fleet
Vehicle booking calendar by project, MOT (roadworthiness test) and insurance reminders, breakdown reports from the phone and check-out and return photos.
Rental quotes
Built from the catalogue, with a price per day. The client accepts them online from a link and the gear is reserved for those dates.
Staff and crew
Staff and crew records, hours allocated to the project from the phone or the Apple Watch, permissions by area and internal chat.
Finance
Quoted, accepted and invoiced amounts by project, client and month, with an Excel report and a connection for Power BI.
IT inventory
Laptops, phones, lines, MiFi routers and licences assigned to each person, with the return list when someone leaves.
pasos: Import what already exists
The inventory, the vehicles and the people are imported from Excel sheets.
Label gear and vehicles
QR labels are printed from Bulx and scanned with any phone.
Work from one place
Bookings, check-outs, quotes and hours are recorded and linked to the project.
faq: What is management software for audiovisual production companies?

It is software that runs the operational side of a production company: what gear there is and where it is, which vehicles are booked, what has been quoted and accepted, and who is working on each project. It is not video editing software or shoot scheduling software.
How does it differ from a project management tool or a generic ERP?

It starts from the way a production company works: items that go out on a shoot and come back, kits, vehicles with MOT dates, quotes by day and by department, crew by project. Generic software requires that work to be adapted to its screens.
What kind of production company is it for?
For advertising, film, television and production service companies that have their own gear, vehicles or a team that goes out on shoots, and for equipment rental houses.
Does it replace accounting software?
No. Bulx handles the quote up to acceptance; the invoice is issued with the usual accounting software and the quote is marked as invoiced.
Is there a trial?
Yes. There is a 14-day free trial, and a demo by video call using the production company’s own gear.

alquiler-material-audiovisual.desc: AV rental software: catalogue with day rates, reservation by date, quotes accepted online and check-outs and returns tracked with QR labels.
alquiler-material-audiovisual.h1: Audiovisual equipment rental, from quote to return.
alquiler-material-audiovisual.sub: For rental houses and for production companies that rent out their own gear. The catalogue has a day rate; the quote is built from it and sent as a link; when the client accepts, the gear is reserved; check-out and return are recorded by scanning the label on each item.
cifras: rate for each item in the catalogue
per quote, with no account needed for the client
bloques: Catalogue with day rates
Each item and each kit has its price per day. The quote calculates the amounts by day and by department, with discounts, and with or without VAT depending on the settings.
Reservation by date
When a quote is accepted, the gear and vehicles are reserved for the project period and cannot be assigned to another project on the same dates.
Online acceptance
The client opens the quote in the browser, in the house style, and accepts it or requests changes. The time it was opened and the time it was accepted are both recorded.
Check-outs and returns with QR
Gear is scanned on the way out and on the way back. Anything missing or returned damaged is flagged on the return, with photos, and creates a repair order.
Client record
Tax details, contacts, terms and all the client’s quotes: accepted, pending and expired, with the amounts for the year.
Documents in the house style
The quote is exported to PDF and to Word with the logo, the tax details and the terms, from the default templates or from one of your own.
pasos: Load the catalogue
It is imported from Excel, with the categories and the day rate of each item.
Quote from the catalogue
Client, dates and gear. The quote is sent by email as a link, and every change creates a version.
Hand over and collect with the label
Check-out and return are recorded by scanning each item or each kit.
faq: Is it suitable for a camera, lighting or grip rental house?
Yes. The catalogue accepts any category of gear, kits with their contents and vehicles, each with its day rate.
Does the client need to register to accept a quote?
No. They receive a link that opens in the browser. The link has an expiry date and can be revoked.
What happens if the client does not reply?
A reminder is sent by email after the configured number of days, and it is logged in the quote history.
Can vehicles be rented out as well?
Yes. Quotes include gear and vehicles, and both are reserved on acceptance.
Does Bulx issue the rental invoices?
No. The invoice is issued with the usual accounting software; in Bulx the quote is marked as invoiced so that the reports reconcile.

inventario-codigos-qr.titulo: QR code inventory for film equipment
inventario-codigos-qr.desc: QR labels for cameras, lights, cases and vehicles: printed from Bulx and scanned with a phone to record check-outs, returns and issues.
inventario-codigos-qr.h1: A QR code inventory for film equipment.
inventario-codigos-qr.sub: Each item, each case and each vehicle carries a label with a QR code. Scanning it with a phone camera opens its record and logs the movement: who takes it, when and for which project. Labels are generated and printed from Bulx.
cifras: items labelled at the production company where it was developed
bloques: Labels generated in Bulx
Bulx assigns a code to each item and generates its label. Labels are printed on any printer, in whichever format is preferred, and can be reprinted.
Scanned with a phone
No barcode scanner is needed and nothing has to be installed: the phone camera opens the record. The iPhone and iPad app has its own scanner.
Check-out and return on the spot
Scanning records who takes the item, when and for which project. On return, what has come back and its condition are checked.
Cases and kits
A case or a kit has its own label and its contents. It goes out and comes back as one unit, and on return it is clear which part is missing.
Vehicles and devices too
Vehicles and IT devices carry labels as well. On a vehicle, the scan records who is taking it and at what mileage.
Public page without sensitive data
Anyone who scans a label without having an account sees a public page for the item that shows neither serial numbers nor prices.
pasos: Add or import the gear
Item by item or from an Excel sheet. Each one is given its code.
Print and stick on the labels
One per item or per case, and one per vehicle.
Scan at every movement
On the way out and on the way back. Each item’s history is kept on its record.
faq: Why QR codes and not barcodes?
Because a QR code can be read with any phone camera, without a scanner, and opens the item record directly in the browser.
What printer is needed?
Any printer. Labels are generated in Bulx and printed on adhesive paper or on a label printer.
What does an outsider see on scanning the label?
A public page for the item, which shows neither serial numbers nor prices.
What happens if a label is damaged?
It is reprinted from Bulx. The item code does not change.
Does it work without signal?
With the app, viewing data that is already loaded and scanning both work offline; changes are sent when the connection returns.

plantilla-inventario-material.desc: Free Excel template for an audiovisual equipment inventory: code, category, quantity, day rate, serial number and location.
plantilla-inventario-material.h1: Inventory template for film equipment, in Excel.
plantilla-inventario-material.sub: A free Excel sheet, with no registration, containing the columns that a production company or a rental house needs for its equipment inventory. It works on its own and, if you later want to move to Bulx, it can be imported without changing anything.
cifras: for Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets
bloques: Code and name
One code per item (for example, CAM-0001) and its name. The name is the only required column; the code is used for the label and to avoid duplicates.
Category and subcategory
In a single column, with the full path separated by ‘ > ’: ‘Lighting > Stands’. This allows the inventory to be filtered and sorted by department.
Quantity
The number of units of that item. For gear with a serial number, one row per unit is advisable; for consumables or identical parts, one row with the quantity.
Price per day
The rental rate for each item, which is the basis of any quote priced by the day.
Serial number and location
The serial number identifies each unit for insurance or repair purposes; the location says which warehouse, shelf or case it is in.
Department and notes
The department it belongs to (camera, lighting, grip, sound) and any remarks: accessories included, condition, purchase date.
pasos: Download and fill in
One row per item, without changing the headers. The second sheet explains each column.
Keep it up to date
Every addition, removal or change of location is noted in the same sheet.
Import it into Bulx, if you wish
Bulx reads the template as it is, creates the categories and assigns a QR label to each item.
faq: Is the template free?
Yes. It can be downloaded without registration and used and modified freely.
Which programs open it?
Microsoft Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets. It is an .xlsx file without macros.
Which columns are required?
Only the name. The rest can be filled in gradually.
When does an Excel sheet stop being enough?

When you need to know who has each item and since when, to prevent something being reserved twice for the same dates, or to record the condition in which gear comes back. A sheet holds the list, not the movements.
Can it be imported into Bulx?
Yes. The template headers are the ones Bulx reads. Before importing, Bulx shows which items will be added and which categories will be created.

faq_general: Do I need to install anything?
No. Bulx is a web application used from the browser. The iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch app is optional and is meant for work done on your feet: scanning, booking and clocking in.
Can the current inventory be imported?
Yes. It is imported from an Excel sheet; Bulx organises it by department and assigns a code to each item. Anything that does not fit is flagged for review.
Each person sees the areas they have permission for: production, fleet, gear, IT. Prices and finance are only visible with Finance permission.
On servers in Frankfurt (Germany), with backups. Every change is recorded with the person, the action and the date.
What size of production company is it meant for?
It was developed at a production company with over 700 items, 29 vehicles and 180 people between staff and crew. It also works for much smaller volumes; there is no minimum.
It depends on the volume of gear and the number of people. It is set out in writing at the demo.
Does it work on a phone?
Yes. The web version is adapted to mobile screens and there is also an app for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch with a label scanner, bookings and chat.
Can it be tried before signing up?
Yes. There is a 14-day free trial that can be started from this website, and the demo uses the production company’s own gear.

importar: This template can be imported into Bulx as it is (Material › Importar Excel): Bulx creates the categories, assigns a QR label to each item and, before importing, shows what will be added. More information at https://bulx.es/en/equipment-inventory-template/
columnas: A short, unique code per item. For example, three letters for the department and a number: CAM-0001. This is the code that goes on the label.
REQUIRED. The name by which the item is known in the warehouse: make, model and whatever distinguishes it.
The full path, separated by ‘ > ’: ‘Lighting > LED’. Any depth can be used.
Units of that item. For gear with a serial number, one row per unit and quantity 1.
Rental rate per day, excluding VAT. Leave it empty if the item is not rented out.
The manufacturer’s serial number. It identifies the unit in the event of an insurance claim, a repair or a theft.
Where it is kept: warehouse, shelf, flight case or box.
Camera, Lighting, Grip, Sound, Production… Whichever is responsible for the item.
Accessories included, condition, purchase date or any other remark.
